notes.author: Maya Lindgren
notes.title: Renewal pre-discussion
notes.body:
# Renewal pre-discussion: Halden Bet

Date: 2026-10-07
Author: Maya Lindgren

Attendees: Halden head of trading, Halden procurement, Maya Lindgren.

- Head of trading mentioned they are trialling another in-play odds supplier "for two leagues" since the summer.
- Procurement wants pricing for a reduced in-play scope at renewal. Budget pressure from their finance team.
- Still positive about the live data feed and pre-match odds.

Actions: Maya to prepare renewal options before notice date.

# Service call: Halden

Date: 2026-06-12
Author: Maya Lindgren

Attendees: Halden trading operations lead, Maya Lindgren, solutions engineer.

- Complaints about in-play price delays during the busy June fixtures. They say traders suspended markets manually several times.
- Asked for a written explanation and service credits.
- Tone noticeably cooler than last quarter.

Actions: solutions engineer to send incident summary; Maya to check SLA credit terms.

notes.title: Quarterly review
notes.body:
# Quarterly review: Halden Bet plc

Date: 2025-11-20
Author: Maya Lindgren

Attendees: Halden head of trading, Halden CTO, Maya Lindgren (account owner).

- Good quarter overall. Trading team happy with in-play coverage and pre-match pricing.
- They raised the price increase at the last renewal again but accepted it "for now".
- Interest in more streaming for lower leagues next year, nothing concrete.

Actions: Maya to share roadmap for in-play latency improvements.
